project_structure: React SPA with custom state management. No React Query/TanStack Query/SWR/Zustand. State is managed via: (1) A hand-rolled external store (chapterStore) using Map-based caches with subscription/emit pattern consumed by React via useSyncExternalStore; (2) useProjectData hook for one-shot data fetching with no automatic cache invalidation; (3) A PersistentOutlet system that keeps the /writing page mounted (hidden via display:none) when navigating to /outline, preventing re-mount and thus preventing useEffect-based refetch on navigation. Backend is FastAPI+SQLAlchemy with chapter numbering computed via _compute_chapter_offset() that sums max local chapter numbers from earlier volumes structure_json.

patterns: State management: (1) Custom chapterStore with Map caches, subscription/emit, useSyncExternalStore bridge. No React Query. (2) Two-phase invalidation: stale=true then separate loadMeta call. (3) PersistentOutlet keeps writing page mounted so mount-based effects skip. (4) Correct pattern (useOutlineSwitcher): markWizardProjectChanged + invalidateProjectChapters + refreshChapters(). (5) Backend numbering: max-of-local-numbers offset.
dependencies: Frontend: React 18 with useSyncExternalStore. react-router-dom with persistent outlet. No state management library. Backend: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy. Chapter numbering from DetailedOutline.structure_json.
integration_points: Bug 1: createChapters() and generateChapterSkeleton() call invalidateProjectChapters() but useChapterMetaList does not auto-refetch on stale. Bug 2: structure_json local numbers fed to _compute_chapter_offset() max-based offset.
